# Camera Coverage

Counts the dataset camera frustums containing each element.

`lfs.camera_coverage` · Selection

## How to use

Use Count with Compare to remove elements seen by too few cameras.\
Checks the image bounds and positive depth, not occlusion. Max Distance 0 disables the distance limit.\
Works with splats, points and mesh vertices; the scene must contain dataset cameras.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Max Distance | `Max Distance` | lfs.float | 0 | min 0; step 0.1 | Maximum distance from a camera in world units; 0, the default, disables this limit. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Count | `Count` | lfs.int | — | — | Number of dataset cameras whose image bounds contain this element. |
| Ratio | `Ratio` | lfs.float | — | — | Visible camera count divided by the total camera count, from 0 to 1. |
